# Curve:point

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the point of the custom curve by index.

```lua
local x = curve:point([indexintegerx])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index(integer),x` | number | optional | and y (number, optional) |

## Returns

x (number) and y (number)
